so_far: Iniya begins renovating her ancestral home to distract herself from her father's death. While clearing out his study, she finds a hidden compartment containing documents that suggest her uncle Kathiravan has forged a will. The episode ends with Kathiravan confronting her in the study, creating a tense standoff.
series.premise_en: After her father's sudden death, a quiet interior designer discovers her greedy uncle has forged documents to seize their ancestral home. She navigates the complex web of family betrayal to reclaim her legacy through calm strategy rather than confrontation.

characters.name: Iniya
characters.appearance_en: Oval face with sharp eyes, tied-back wavy hair, wears cotton salwar kameez with minimal silver jewelry.

characters.name: Kathiravan
characters.appearance_en: Square jawline, grey-streaked short hair, always wears formal half-sleeve shirts and a gold watch.

characters.name: Madhavi
characters.appearance_en: Round face, soft features, long braided hair, wears simple silk sarees with a prominent pottu.

characters.name: Vetri
characters.appearance_en: Angular face, short-cropped modern haircut, wears branded polo shirts and watches.

arc: Iniya discovers the forged will during a routine renovation of the family house.
Kathiravan successfully gaslights the family into believing Iniya is mentally unstable.
Iniya begins documenting the financial irregularities in the family business secretly.
Vetri attempts to sabotage Iniya's career, leading to a public confrontation at a family function.
Iniya finds an unlikely ally in a former employee who witnessed the forgery years ago.
The family secret involving a hidden debt is revealed, turning the siblings against Kathiravan.
A tense legal standoff occurs where Iniya presents evidence that shifts the power balance.
Justice is served as the property is legally restored, and Iniya reconciles the broken family unit.

so_far: On her deathbed, Sevvali Paati gives Vaanathi a bundle of palm leaves. The siblings and fisher boy Paal decode the first clue pointing to a hollow tamarind tree in a monsoon forest. With forest guide Ilavarasu, they trek through rain and leeches, find the tree, and extract a carved stone marker. As they examine it, Kalai spots fresh footprints and cut marks — Marudhan's men have been there. The episode ends with the group realizing they are being watched from the tree line, and Marudhan himself steps into view, stick raised.
series.title_en: Sea, Forest, Temple: The Palm-Leaf Trail
series.premise_en: On her deathbed, grandmother Sevvali Paati hands her grandchildren a crumbling bundle of palm leaves that reveals their ancestors were guild surveyors who hid a coastal kingdom's water secret before a sea raid four centuries ago. Three siblings and a fisher boy follow the trail from a monsoon forest in the hills to a reef wreck and up to a hilltop temple, with a ruthless antique dealer always one step behind. What waits at the end is not gold but the power to end a village's drought, if the children reach it first.

characters.name: வானதி (Vaanathi)
characters.role: 16-year-old protagonist; reads old palm-leaf Tamil script; leads the decoding of every clue
characters.appearance_en: Lean girl with wheat-brown skin, oval face, a small mole below her left eye, thick black hair in one long braid tied with red thread; faded teal cotton kurta over blue jeans, brown canvas satchel across her chest, black rubber sandals.

characters.name: தென்னவன் (Thennavan)
characters.role: 22-year-old elder brother; blacksmith's apprentice; strength and stubborn protectiveness
characters.appearance_en: Broad-shouldered young man with dark brown skin, short cropped hair, heavy eyebrows and a thin scar on his right forearm; grey sleeveless vest, dark green rolled trousers, thin steel chain, small iron hammer hooked at his waist.

characters.name: கலை (Kalai)
characters.role: 13-year-old little brother; comic relief, sharp memory, records everything on an old camera
characters.appearance_en: Small wiry boy with a gap-toothed grin, dense curly black hair, round cheeks; bright yellow t-shirt with a tiger print, khaki shorts, one sock pulled up and one down, scuffed white shoes, black camera on a strap around his neck.

characters.name: பால்கடல் 'பால்' (Paalkadal 'Paal')
characters.role: 18-year-old fisher boy next door; free-diver who guides the sea leg of the journey
characters.appearance_en: Tall lanky boy with deep sun-tanned skin, sun-bleached brown curls, wide friendly eyes; faded red bandana knotted on his head, sleeveless blue-and-white checked shirt, rolled shorts, sea-glass bead necklace, bare feet.

characters.name: செவ்வலிப் பாட்டி (Sevvali Paati)
characters.role: 78-year-old grandmother; keeper of the family's oral history and the palm-leaf bundle
characters.appearance_en: Tiny bent old woman with silver hair in a low bun studded with white jasmine, deep wrinkles, thick black-rimmed glasses; mustard-yellow sari with brown border, grey shawl over one shoulder, brass key ring tied at her waist.

characters.name: இளவரசு (Ilavarasu)
characters.role: 34-year-old forest guide from a hill hamlet; knows the tiger corridors and the old survey paths
characters.appearance_en: Tall lean man with very dark skin, sharp cheekbones, long black hair tied low at the nape; maroon shirt with rolled sleeves, khaki trousers, cloth bundle slung across his back, machete at his hip, white bone bead bracelet on his right wrist.

characters.name: சுரங்கி (Surangi)
characters.role: 26-year-old marine researcher who joins the reef dive and reads the shipwreck's markings
characters.appearance_en: Round cheerful face with sun spots across the nose, black hair in two short plaits; navy blue rash guard with an orange stripe, orange knee-length shorts, dive mask pushed up on her forehead, grey fins carried in one hand.

characters.name: மருதன் (Marudhan)
characters.role: 46-year-old antique dealer and main antagonist; hunts the same treasure to sell abroad
characters.appearance_en: Heavy-set man with salt-and-pepper hair combed straight back, thick gold-rimmed glasses, a trimmed moustache; crisp cream silk shirt, beige trousers, heavy gold ring on his left hand, dark wooden walking stick with a brass handle.

characters.name: தெய்வசிகாமணி (Deivashigamani)
characters.role: 63-year-old guardian priest of the hill temple; holds the final piece of the puzzle
characters.appearance_en: Thin tall old man, bald crown with white hair at the sides, three white vibhuti lines across his forehead; plain white dhoti and white shawl, wooden staff with a small brass bell, copper water pot at his side.

arc: Sevvali Paati's palm-leaf bundle sends Vaanathi, Thennavan, Kalai and Paal into a monsoon forest, where a hollow tamarind tree yields a carved stone marker and they realise Marudhan's men are tracking them.
Guided by Ilavarasu across a flooded river gorge, the children reach a hidden rock shelter and copy a coastal survey map, but Marudhan snatches the original and a landslide traps the group overnight.
In a fishing village, Surangi and Paal take the children to a reef wreck where they raise a bronze lamp whose inscription names a hill temple and the ninth lamp of its festival corridor.

Climbing to the hill temple during the lamp festival, the children solve Deivashigamani's shadow-and-lamp riddle and open a sealed vault beneath the sanctum, finding granary records, manuscripts and a sluice plan instead of gold.

When Marudhan breaks the vault's water channel, the children rescue him from the flood and restore the ancient spring line to the drought-hit village, revealing their ancestors built the secret to give water, not to hoard it.

so_far: At the Kodaikanal observatory, astronomer Meera analyzes satellite data and calculates a massive solar storm will strike Earth in 7 days, collapsing all power grids. She calls her auto-driver father Selvam in Chennai to prepare. Suddenly, senior official Raghavan and an assistant enter the lab, demanding she halt and surrender the data. Meera secretly copies the files onto a hidden drive, evades their grasp, and sprints into the foggy night, reaching the perimeter fence as a black SUV blocks the mountain road ahead.
series.premise_en: Meera, a young astronomer at a Kodaikanal observatory, discovers that a giant solar storm will black out the whole world in 7 days. Nobody believes her, secretive officials try to silence her, and she races to Chennai to protect her father and little brother, and finally to save the city's power grid.

characters.name: மீரா
characters.role: young astronomer, brave and clever heroine
characters.appearance_en: slim Tamil woman, black hair in a loose braid, round black glasses, maroon kurta with a grey hoodie, ID card lanyard

characters.name: செல்வம்
characters.role: Meera's father, a kind Chennai auto-rickshaw driver
characters.appearance_en: thin Tamil man, grey moustache, short grey hair, khaki shirt, white veshti

characters.name: அர்ஜுன்
characters.appearance_en: small Tamil boy, messy hair, blue school t-shirt, red backpack

characters.name: ராகவன்
characters.role: cold, secretive senior official who wants the news hidden
characters.appearance_en: tall Tamil man, neat grey beard, black coat, rimless glasses

characters.name: கார்த்திக்
characters.role: Meera's journalist friend who slowly believes her
characters.appearance_en: Tamil man, short beard, checked shirt, camera bag

arc: Day 7: at night in the Kodaikanal lab Meera finds a giant sunspot; her maths says a solar storm hits in 7 days and every light, phone and hospital machine will die. She calls her father. Two men in black coats walk in and order her to stop. Cliffhanger: she escapes with a copy of the data.
Day 6: a tense escape down the misty ghat road to Chennai; the men follow; small strange signs begin (phones glitching, a faint red glow in the sky). Cliffhanger: Raghavan is waiting at her home.
Day 5: Raghavan says the panic would be worse than the storm. Meera and journalist Karthik try to warn the public; their video vanishes. Cliffhanger: Arjun overhears something terrible.
Day 4: the family prepares while neighbours laugh at them; Arjun finds a secret list of the few people who will be protected. Cliffhanger: their names are not on it, and Raghavan's is.
Day 3: the sky turns red at night and people start to believe; panic in the city. Meera learns why Raghavan hid the truth. Cliffhanger: Selvam goes missing in the crowd.
Day 2: Meera finds the real hope: if the city switches off its grid just before the storm, the transformers survive. She must reach the control centre. Cliffhanger: Raghavan blocks the door.

Day 1 to zero hour: Raghavan finally helps; the switch-off happens seconds before the storm; the whole world goes dark, but Chennai's lights come back first. The family is together, Selvam is a hero, and a final quiet twist about the next storm sets up a possible season 2.
